zh.title: 民航局舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇 邀國外專家交流
zh.summary: 民航局11月23日舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇，邀請國外民航機關及專家交流。
body: 交通部民用航空局11月23日舉辦「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」。論壇聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範介紹，並邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗。
民航局表示，希望透過國外專家分享，促進臺灣無人機產業及制度與國際接軌。民航局指出，先進空中交通從技術研發走向實際營運，仍須建立適航認證、安全監理與空域整合機制。
民航局也提到，電動垂直起降航空器（eVTOL）等新興技術，未來有機會拓展都市及區域運輸、緊急救援與偏遠地區交通服務。

en.title: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration holds drone and advanced air mobility forum
en.summary: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration held a drone and advanced air mobility forum on November 23, inviting overseas experts.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration held the 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility (AAM) on November 23. The forum focused on international drone and AAM development and international aviation safety standards, with overseas civil aviation authorities and experts invited to share practical experience.

The agency said it hoped that sharing by foreign experts would help Taiwan's drone industry and related systems align internationally. It said airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration mechanisms would still be needed for AAM to move from research and development to practical operations.

The agency also said emerging technologies such as electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft could eventually expand urban and regional transport, emergency rescue and transport services in remote areas.
